scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,backend,web -c yellow,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @pokemon-universe/server" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev -w @pokemon-universe/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/shared && npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/server && npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/shared && npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/server && npm run typecheck -w @pokemon-universe/web && npm run typecheck -w @pokemon-universe/e2e && tsc -p packages/shared/golden/tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run check:boundaries && npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/shared && npm run check:registry && npm run build -w @pokemon-universe/server && npm run check:golden && npm run check:api-types && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
